review_candidates.description: Company Description El Marakby Steel, established in 2006 in 6th of October City, is a key player in Egypt’s steel industry, focused on quality and safe operations. The company operates a rolling mill plant over 16,000 m², producing more than 250,000 tons of steel rebars annually in sizes from 10mm to 32mm, following British and American standards. A modern melt shop, constructed by SMS Group, is designed to produce 350,000 tons of billets and has been in operation since June 2016. As part of El Marakby Group, which includes four established companies, El Marakby Steel is committed to international standards, sustainable technology, and continuous operational upgrades led by a qualified team to strengthen its presence in the Egyptian market. Job Responsibilities Follow up on regular mechanical inspections to identify required preventive and corrective maintenance activities. Monitor preventive and corrective maintenance activities to minimize equipment breakdowns and production downtime. Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis of mechanical failures and recommend appropriate corrective actions. Coordinate the availability of spare parts and materials required for maintenance and breakdown repairs. Follow up on the receipt and inspection of purchased and workshop-manufactured spare parts to ensure compliance with required specifications. Monitor spare parts purchase requests, stock levels, and consumption to ensure availability and control operating costs. Supervise equipment handover after overhauls and ensure equipment readiness for operation. Execute scheduled maintenance and repair activities according to mechanical maintenance procedures and guidelines. Follow up on daily maintenance reports and departmental inspection plans. Prepare daily shift reports and support training plans for maintenance team members based on performance analysis. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical Engineering. 1–2 years of relevant experience in mechanical maintenance. Previous experience in steel plants, preferably in the Melting Department, is highly preferred. Good command of Microsoft Office. AutoCAD & SolidWorks experience is a must. Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and teamwork skills. Apply Now If you have the required experience and are interested in joining our team, please send your updated CV to Careers@elmarakbysteel.com

Your job will be to design, build, and deliver real-time applications that support the production management of mobile robots, lifts, cases, and warehouse automation hardware. As a senior technical contributor, you will help develop production-quality software across web, desktop, mobile, and backend platforms while collaborating closely with engineers, product managers, and cross-functional teams. What We Do The Software Engineering Team is part of the Technology organization , which is responsible for building and delivering the software platforms that power Symbotic's AI-driven warehouse automation solutions. Our teams develop the applications, services, and user experiences that enable real-time control, monitoring, and optimization of robotic systems used by some of the world's largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. What You’ll Do Design and develop real-time applications for production management of mobile robots, lifts, cases, and hardware Develop applications that span desktop, mobile and web technology stacks utilizing the following technologies{{:}} recent React or Angular, C# .NET, XAML, RabbitMQ, SQL Build responsive React components and modules (HTML, CSS/SCSS, TypeScript) with a focus on reusable patterns Integrate with backend services{{:}} consume REST APIs, exchange messages via RabbitMQ, and leverage SignalR for real-time updates Write maintainable code with unit tests; contribute to end-to-end and component tests as needed Collaborate with other development teams and product managers to break down requirements, define API contracts, and execute new business requirements Communicate effectively with engineers, UX/UI, DevOps, and management; provide clear written designs, status updates, and documentation Implement and maintain internationalization and localization across the product Maintain regular collaboration overlap during 9am–5pm Eastern Time What You’ll Need Degree in Computer Science, a related technical discipline, or related experience 4–8 years’ professional experience developing software applications Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including with engineers, UX/UI, DevOps, and management 3+ years of experience with HTML, CSS/SCSS, TypeScript, and React or Angular 3+ years of experience in C# and .NET Experience with RabbitMQ and SignalR Self-motivated, with an ability to learn quickly and independently, and work in a dynamic agile environment with cross functional and remote teams Our Environment Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com.
